notes.title: Discover the Unique Features of Robin in da Hood
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

We’ve seen some concerns about our upcoming game [b]Robin in da Hood[/b] and its similarities to Rustler. We want to clear up any confusion and share some exciting news about our project.

First and foremost, we have officially licensed the assets and source code from Rustler creators. This means we are legally allowed to use these resources in [b]Robin in da Hood[/b]. We chose this route to quickly present the core concept of our game and show you what we’re aiming to create.

Here are some of the key changes and features we are implementing:
[list]
[*] [b]New UI:[/b] We’re designing a fresh, user-friendly interface to enhance your gameplay experience.
[*] [b]Voice Overs:[/b] Expect engaging voice acting to bring our quirky characters to life.
[*] [b]Stealth Mechanics:[/b] Sneak your way through missions with newly added stealth options.
[*] [b]Camera Rotation:[/b] Enjoy the freedom of rotating the camera to get the best view of the action.
[*] [b]Original Locations:[/b] All in-game locations will be uniquely crafted to immerse you in our version of medieval England.
[/list]
These updates and features will make Robin in da Hood stand out and offer a fresh, fun adventure. We appreciate your patience and support as we continue to develop the game.

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready for a medieval romp like no other!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2800320/Robin_In_Da_Hood/
